items.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
items.summary: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.

items.title: Cyber attacks affect UK meat processing industry, top security official says
items.summary: Cyber attacks have affected the UK meat processing industry, a top security official has said in the wake of hacks that hit supermarkets across Europe.

items.title: King calls slave trade a 'shameful chapter' during Commonwealth address
items.summary: The speech comes after calls for the UK government to issue a formal apology for Britain's historic role in the trade.

items.title: Reform councillor charged with 35 offences including rape
items.summary: A Reform UK councillor has been charged with 35 offences, including 12 counts of rape, the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) said.

items.title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored
items.summary: Researchers have detected signals from the smallest distances ever probed.

items.title: Bomb threats reported on multiple flights, including two from UK airports
items.summary: At least seven flights, including two from the UK, have been affected by bomb threats, which caused unplanned landings and temporary airport closures.
